summary: Context-only committee read: the US backdrop is MIXED (43), not a calibrated risk-off edge. The confirmed Q2 label is lagging axes that currently indicate Q3, while restrictive and rising real rates, a bear steepener, stronger USD, weak breadth, BROKEN leadership, widening HY credit, and aligned systematic cutting describe a fragile transition. Offsetting evidence remains material: recession signal is off, financial conditions are still loose, systemic stress is calm, liquidity quantity is expanding, and the risk-radar caution cell’s measured 21-day drawdown rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Accordingly this memo originates no position, probability, ranking, or escalation.
what_fired: Confirmed regime label Q2 conflicts with current Q3-sign axes; Q3 confirmation is only 1 of 7 sessions.
Leadership deteriorated from CRACKING to BROKEN while breadth remains near the 15th percentile and HY OAS widened.
Risk radar shows credit/growth conjunction, but remains advisory and below its own measured base-rate threshold.
Factor weather is mixed with profitability leading; the factor panel has only 11 dates, Pair G is dormant, and factor attention has no graded history.

Four shadow attention records were filed with pre-committed falsifiers: regime label/axis reconciliation, leadership-credit-breadth persistence, overdue Long Treasuries thesis review, and overdue China-overweight thesis review.
contradictions_review: The central contradiction is defensive tape versus incomplete macro confirmation: poor breadth, broken leadership, credit widening, a firm dollar, and short gamma coexist with loose financial conditions, expanding liquidity quantity, low recession risk, calm systemic stress, and a below-base caution-cell drawdown rate. The Q2 regime label also conflicts with its own current axes and with the growth-scare radar. Factor Pair G contributes no current contradiction because its ledger is dormant until at least 60 panel dates. Open Master Brain theses require attention where current evidence conflicts: the Long Treasuries overweight has met its stated invalidating conditions (real 10-year yield 2.8% and bear steepening), and the China-equities overweight is inconsistent with fresh-enough regime context showing Q3/contracting liquidity plus strained leadership; the dedicated China market-state surface is stale.
